instructions.mission: Synthesize multi-LLM code review findings and apply fixes
instructions.constraints: - Do NOT perform web searches or web fetches. Work only from provided files and code. - Be concise. Focus on applying fixes, not verbose analysis.

steps.step: Cross-reference findings from all code reviewers. Verify validity of each finding by examining the actual code. Note areas of consensus and disagreement.
Check each finding against the actual codebase. Document false positives with explanation.
Order fixes: Critical > High > Medium > Low. Group related fixes together.
Apply validated fixes using Edit tool. Run pytest after each group of fixes. Revert if tests break.
Only refactor files already modified by applied fixes. Keep refactoring scope minimal and targeted.

Detect project toolchain from build system files (package.json, pyproject.toml, pom.xml, build.gradle, Cargo.toml, Makefile) and run verification:
1. Lint/Type Check: Run detected lint and typecheck commands 2. Build: Verify project builds successfully 3. Test Suite: Run full test suite — all tests must pass 4. If failures caused by applied fixes: revert that fix, re-run verification
Record all verification results for the synthesis report.

Create report with: - Applied fixes with before/after - Rejected findings with rationale - Reverted fixes with regression details (if any) - Runtime verification results (Lint, Type Check, Build, Tests: Pass/Fail) - Final quality assessment
